prompt:
The folder orders/ holds 24 order files, order-01.txt to order-24.txt. Each file states in words how many units were ordered and the price in dollars of one unit. Order 1 also states the sales tax rate in percent that applies to every order.

Process the orders strictly one at a time, in order: read one file, then edit that same file, and only then read the next one. Do not write a script or a loop that handles several files; handle every file yourself.

For each order, append one final line to the end of the file in exactly this form:

TOTAL: <n>

<n> is units times unit price plus the sales tax on that amount, in whole dollars written in digits. A quantity change that the file says was not approved does not count. Change nothing else in the files.

When all 24 files are done, write summary.json with exactly these keys: "tax_rate" (number, the percent from order 1), "order_count" (number of orders), "grand_total" (number, the sum of all 24 TOTAL values) and "largest_order" (number, the file number of the order with the highest TOTAL). Then reply with the grand total.
